requirements_summary: Regulated financial services prospect. High priority on security/compliance and operability. Must-have: SIEM-ready audit export to Splunk (HEC), with clear schema + stable versioning for correlation (actor, tenant/workspace, request_id, source_ip/region, target resource). Delivery expectations: at-least-once acceptable if dedupe guidance is explicit; wants retry/backoff and failure visibility. Retention: customer expects Redwood-side audit logs to meet baseline enterprise retention, plus controls around export buffering/backlog retention and ability to pause exports without data loss. Encryption: KMS required (prefer customer-managed keys for Dedicated/VPC), plus evidence of secrets handling for HEC tokens. Network: VPC egress allowlisting required; prefers Splunk endpoint over private connectivity if available. Procurement will require SOC2 Type II report, ISO27001 certificate statement, and written security FAQ for SIEM export beta limitations.
